description: An upright rounded-rectangle document. A large dollar sign sits in the upper half, above two horizontal text lines, the lower one shorter than the upper.
A closed fist enters from the left, with a squared cuff at the wrist, and grips the bottom of an upright banknote. The note tapers slightly toward the fist and carries a single circle at its centre.

A small video camera at the upper left tilts down toward a shopping basket at the lower right. The basket has a triangular handle, a trapezoidal body with two short slots, and two signal arcs above it.

A hand enters from the lower right and holds a rounded card tilted on a diagonal, its fingers wrapping the lower edge. A euro sign sits on the card, and two curved signal arcs radiate from its upper-left end.

A hand enters from the lower right and holds a rounded card tilted on a diagonal, its fingers wrapping the lower edge. A pound sign sits on the card, and two curved signal arcs radiate from its upper-left end.

A hand enters from the lower right and holds a rounded card tilted on a diagonal, its fingers wrapping the lower edge. A yuan sign sits on the card, and two curved signal arcs radiate from its upper-left end.

A hand enters from the lower right and holds a rounded card tilted on a diagonal, its fingers wrapping the lower edge. A dollar sign sits on the card, and two curved signal arcs radiate from its upper-left end.
A hand enters from the left, palm up with the thumb curling over, and holds out a landscape credit card to the right. The card has a horizontal stripe near its top and a short line on its face.
A landscape rounded-rectangle card. Two equal overlapping circles sit side by side across its centre, forming the interlocking card-network mark.
A hand rises from below and grips the right end of a landscape card, the curled index finger wrapping over its edge. The card has a horizontal stripe near its top and a short line beneath.
A landscape rounded-rectangle card with a horizontal magnetic stripe band near its top. The italic VISA wordmark sits in the lower-right corner of the card face.
A round coin marked with a bitcoin B sits on a diagonal between two hands. One hand reaches in from the upper left and the other from the lower right, each gripping an opposite edge.
An open envelope with its flap folded back and diagonal fold lines on its front. An upright sheet rises out of it, with two short text lines beside a dollar sign near its top.
A kiosk screen shows a two-by-two grid of square tiles beside a dollar sign, on a short neck above a flat base. A hand rises from the lower right with its index finger touching the screen.
A tall smartphone with a dollar sign and a lower bezel stands at the right, two signal arcs above it. At the left, a small register display sits on a post atop a trapezoidal stand on a counter.
